0.content: BUDGET-A · 采石场月报：南坡出料四百二十车，北坡因渗水停工六日；石匠三人告假，学徒两人转去修堤。Quarry monthly report: four hundred and twenty carts from the south face, six days lost to seepage on the north face, three masons on leave, two apprentices reassigned to the levee. 运料的骡队改走旧道，桥板需要在春汛前更换，账上还差一笔石灰的钱。The mule teams now take the old road, the bridge planks must be replaced before the spring flood, and the lime is still unpaid for. 附记：雨季里所有露天堆料都要盖席，否则边角会碎成粉末。Note: cover every open stockpile during the rains or the edges crumble to powder.
